Name: Nob
Description: The priests' town near Jerusalem where David, fleeing Saul, received the showbread from Ahimelech and took Goliath's sword, and where Saul afterward had the priests killed. It was later resettled after the exile.
BiblicalSignificance: Nob is where David received the showbread in his flight, and where Saul's vengeance fell on the priests.
